coeversion.text: Mod header line. The game accepts it and ignores the value.

modversion.text: Mod header line. The game accepts it and ignores the value.

+minunitshere.text: Event condition: true when the current square holds at least the given number of units of the named monster. The player filters by owner: -1 any, -2 the event player, -3 the square's owner, -4 the army's owner.

+seasonleft.text: Event condition: true when the number of turns left in the current season equals the value.

adventurer.text: Marks the monster as an adventurer. A party leader with pickupadvent recruits unled adventurers of its own side from its square. Use the value 1; other values do nothing.

brigand.text: Marks the monster as a brigand. A party leader with pickupbrigands recruits unled brigands of its own side from its square. Use the value 1; other values do nothing.

pickupadvent.text: The unit recruits unled adventurers (monsters with adventurer 1) of its own side standing on its square into its party. Any value above 0 switches it on.

pickupbrigands.text: The unit recruits unled brigands (monsters with brigand 1) of its own side standing on its square into its party. Any value above 0 switches it on.

partyleader.text: Accepted, but nothing in the 5.42 game reads it.

holyvengeance.text: Strikes back at undead and demonic attackers. When one of them hurts the unit, the game rolls 2d4 (open-ended) plus value−1; if that beats the attacker's magic resistance, the attacker takes the same damage. Shown in game as "Holy Vengeance".

citadel2.text: Marks the monster as liking citadels, like the other "…2" terrain flags: as an independent it keeps to citadel squares and the squares next to them.

affectfemale.text: Weapon flag: the weapon only hurts female targets and does no damage to anything else. Shown in game as "(only affects females)".

reclimiter.limit: Up to 12 per recruit entry; extra lines are ignored.

addstring.limit: Up to 58 strings per ritual; extra lines are ignored.

newritual.limit: A ritual holds up to 20 effects; further effect lines are ignored.

newmonster.limit: Mod monsters are numbered from 2000. The game holds up to 5998 monsters; past that newmonster creates nothing.

addunitrec.limit: A class holds up to 160 recruit entries.

addmercrec.limit: A class holds up to 160 recruit entries.

addcomrec.limit: A class holds up to 160 recruit entries.

startitem.limit: Up to 4 per monster; a 5th fails to load with "did nothing".

meleeweapon.limit: Up to 15 weapons per monster; more are dropped.

cost.limit: Up to 4 cost entries per ritual; more are ignored.

newclass.limit: Up to 199 classes; further newclass lines are ignored.
